post.meaning: Whoever puts their trust in God, He is enough for them.
post.caption:
وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُۥٓ

जो अल्लाह पर भरोसा करे, उसके लिए वही काफ़ी है।

Whoever puts their trust in God, He is enough for them.

— Quran, At-Talaq 65:3

reel.meaning: What you hold in your heart through life is what you will hold at the end. Begin remembering now.
reel.caption:
अन्तकाले च मामेव स्मरन्मुक्त्वा कलेवरम्।
यः प्रयाति स मद्भावं याति नास्त्यत्र संशयः॥

अंत समय वही याद आता है जो जीवन भर याद रहा; इसलिए अभी से स्मरण करो।

What you hold in your heart through life is what you will hold at the end. Begin remembering now.

— Bhagavad Gita, 8.5
